prompt:
A desktop landing page for "Cak Mimin — Bumbu Rujak Manis", an East Javanese family business selling ready-made sweet rujak dressing made with real palm sugar (gula aren asli) and no preservatives (tanpa pengawet). Rendered edge to edge as a finished web page, landscape 3:2, crisp readable Indonesian text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is a home cook, a rujak seller or a traveller looking for oleh-oleh, deciding whether to order. This comp is led by the palm-sugar journey. The first viewport: a huge split block of dark glistening gula aren (the coconut-shell moulded kind) and a stone cobek of thick dark-brown rujak sauce with sliced green mango, bengkuang, jambu air and pineapple, cut into the layout like an editorial food-magazine spread. Headline: "Manisnya dari nira, bukan dari pabrik." Subline: "Bumbu rujak manis racikan Cak Mimin. Gula aren asli, tanpa pengawet." Primary button: "Pesan via WhatsApp". The start of the next section is visible: "Cerita Cak Mimin" as a vertical journey of four stages — Nira, Wajan, Cobek, Piring.

Frame: wordmark "Cak Mimin" top left; navigation Cerita, Varian, Cara Ngerujak, Testimoni, Kemitraan; a small WhatsApp order button top right.

Visual law: the ground is deep gula-aren brown moving into molten caramel amber — not cream, not white. Banana-leaf green and chili red are the only accents. Headlines in a bold, characterful high-contrast serif with Javanese editorial gravity; body in a plain sturdy sans. Signature: a faint batik kawung pattern pressed into the brown like an emboss, and real appetising food photography.
